hardRules.rule: One active task at a time (WIP=1).
User approves every merge and every idea; agents never merge.
Dev before/after local test report (md+pdf). QA previous-vs-current report with screenshots (md+pdf). Both required before merge.
Append only to hash-chained ticket_events; never rewrite history.
Story points Fibonacci 1/2/3/5/8/13; day estimates round up to nearest Fib at or above (4 days = 5 points).
Builder owns the flow/path; backup only when owner OFF, over WIP, or reassigned; handoff logged in ticket_events + handover doc.
Dependency gate: requester A E2E-tests B whole implementation before B awaiting_merge.
Designer HTML+image mocks for every state; PO/SM review then user approval before develop.
FE/BE changes require api_contract; contract_test before merge.
Ideas: research → CEO/CFO comment validation → versioned revisions → user Approve/Decline.
Red/blue findings become tickets; local allowlist only; strip secrets from red runtime.
Load only ticket, contract, owned paths; use summaries/diffs; never whole repo.
Never print secrets, tokens, or credentials.
